allowed_skips.reason: RUN_E2E_TESTS hides a legacy in-process TestClient suite. It patches absent module functions (generate_state, validate_jwt, post_grade, get_line_items, get_membership), mixes outdated routes and conditional assertions. Replace with current contracts; enabling infrastructure alone cannot make it valid.

Blanket RUN_E2E_TESTS gate covers mocked TestClient journeys, absent validation/NRPS/AGS patch targets and assertions accepting auth or validation failures. These are outdated harness tests, not proof pending a live Blackboard environment.

RUN_E2E_TESTS is unset. Tests launch Chromium/Firefox/WebKit and navigate a dashboard at localhost:5173 with API localhost:8000. Browser availability and running app prerequisites are real; this baseline does not claim dashboard/assistive-technology acceptance.
Four real Playwright-browser cases are individually gated by RUN_E2E_TESTS; mocked unit cases in the same module execute. Requires installed browsers and isolated test servers.

Real PostgreSQL downgrade refusal/preservation needs explicit TEST_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL and ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_MIGRATION_TESTS=1; ordinary CI invocation lacks those opt-ins. Static migration guards still execute.

RUN_E2E_TESTS hides mocked TestClient journeys with absent get_canvas_oauth_config/exchange_canvas_code/refresh_canvas_token patches, fake bearer auth and assertions accepting 401/404. Replace outdated harness with actual route and dependency contracts; not live Canvas evidence.

Ten observed migration execution/schema/data preservation cases require explicit TEST_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL and destructive-test guard. Their actual Alembic/database operations cannot run in the ordinary non-opted-in suite.

Real PostgreSQL cancellation, leases, claims, atomicity and worker races require TEST_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL plus disposable/destructive guard. Ordinary suite lacks it; separate required worker PostgreSQL lane must prove execution. Fixture fails instead of skips when REQUIRE_WORKER_POSTGRES_TESTS is set.

Explicit skip quarantines a faulty mock that searches SQLAlchemy condition stringification for literal email values. Test logic needs a real expression-aware fixture or deterministic query mock; no external service is needed.

Blanket RUN_E2E_TESTS gate hides local mocked provider journeys. Paths use /api/google while mounted router is /google; scan/remediate resource path contracts also differ, and assertions accept 401/404. Needs current-route/dependency harness replacement, not live Google credentials.

Six explicit skips patch nonexistent provider test_connection/revoke_token methods or nonexistent webhook-manager module methods. Existing route implementation needs current mocks and meaningful assertions.

Legacy generic job CRUD/enqueue/progress/retry/stats endpoints targeted by these tests are not exposed. Current /api/jobs router exposes worker-status only; provider job routes are separate. This records the currently unsupported generic surface, not absence of a working durable queue or a promise to add it.

Module-level missing-REST-router skip also hides four worker tests that only await the patched mock itself. They never invoke production worker code and belong to the old Redis-style harness; replace/remove with evidence from current durable-worker tests.

Observed availability and PDF-generation checks require local LuaLaTeX/LaTeXML/pdflatex tools (five specifically require LuaLaTeX); ordinary CI lacks the toolchain. Additional runtime pikepdf/conversion-failure skips must not be mistaken for the observed prerequisite skip.

RUN_E2E_TESTS unnecessarily gates local fixture/string processing, MathML conversion and HTML export. process_latex is an in-process wrapper and needs no running infrastructure. Assertions may need repair, but the blanket infrastructure reason is false.

All 22 tests are skipped as CRUD router unimplemented, but list/create/delete/update registration routes already exist in integration_routes. Replace stale patch-based dependency handling as needed and restore coverage of current routes; unsupported classification would be false.

RUN_E2E_TESTS hides local mocked Graph journeys with /api/microsoft paths, while current router is mounted as /microsoft; success assertions also accept auth/not-found failures. Replace outdated route/fixture contracts rather than claiming live Microsoft prerequisites.

Two real PostgreSQL JSONB/replay/constraint tests require explicit TEST_TASK8_POSTGRES_URL. Tests create/drop isolated schema objects and are deliberately not enabled by the ordinary DB configuration.

RUN_E2E_TESTS hides local mocked Moodle journeys with absent get_moodle_oauth_config/exchange_moodle_code/refresh_moodle_token patch targets, fake auth and permissive status assertions. A live Moodle instance cannot repair this outdated harness.
Actual PostgreSQL row-lock serialization between fix writing and artifact approval requires explicit TEST_TASK8_POSTGRES_URL and isolated schema; static lock-order and mocked gate tests still run.

Two optional PostgreSQL migration/FK/parent-cleanup checks require TEST_DATABASE_URL with PostgreSQL scheme. They perform real Alembic/model database work and are not covered by memory SQLite behavior.
Real migration upgrade and reloaded mapper-column verification requires PostgreSQL TEST_DATABASE_URL. Other local transactional/mocked atomicity cases are not skipped by this guard.

Concurrent refresh row-lock verification requires explicit TEST_DATABASE_URL and a real PostgreSQL service. This is separate from the deterministic session-rotation tests that execute in the ordinary suite.
pyannote.audio is absent (HAS_PYANNOTE gate). Test covers optional pipeline initialization or no-token fallback; its weak bool assertion is not model-quality/diarization acceptance.
Real migration downgrade/re-upgrade requires explicit TEST_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL and ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_MIGRATION_TESTS=1 on a disposable PostgreSQL database.
Real concurrent enqueue unique-constraint race requires explicit TEST_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL and disposable/destructive guard; missing/unavailable PostgreSQL is skipped by its fixture.
Fresh upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade preservation needs explicit TEST_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL and ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE_MIGRATION_TESTS=1. Static revision/schema-contract tests still execute.

Real asyncpg concurrency test attempts explicit TEST_DATABASE_URL or local aelira_test fallback; unavailable PostgreSQL causes skip. Embedding provider calls are mocked with httpx; this is database evidence, not a live model/provider check.

RUN_E2E_TESTS gates scanner cases that render local HTML and SPA fixture pages through Playwright. Requires browser runtime; AI case permits optional Ollama availability. No LMS/cloud account is a prerequisite. This records missing execution, not accessibility conformance.

Module-level infrastructure gate unnecessarily skips constructor configuration and SPA enum assertions that do not launch a browser or contact a service. Move to ordinary local tests or narrow the gate.

RUN_E2E_TESTS hides legacy TestClient webhook tests with synthetic channels/subscriptions but no valid database fixtures, outdated management paths, nonexistent webhook-manager patch target and assertions accepting rejected/missing routes. Current webhook handlers exist; replace harness with deterministic current-contract coverage. Enabling live provider infrastructure alone does not validate these tests.

Unconditional skip retires a SQLite concurrency attempt explicitly superseded by real PostgreSQL child-reap/cancellation matrix. PostgreSQL replacement must execute in its required lane; counting this dead test as coverage would be false.
